You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration with "DONE" while in the Living room, failing to check if all reachable directions from the current node and previously visited nodes had been fully explored. Specifically, upon returning to the Living room, I had available directions "west" and "east". I had previously visited "west" (leading to Pantry) and "east" (leading to Utility room), but I failed to verify if the Utility room had unexplored exits or if the Pantry had unexplored exits that I hadn't revisited. My mistake was assuming the map was complete based on the number of unique nodes visited rather than ensuring every edge from every visited node had been traversed. Next time, I will maintain a strict checklist of "unexplored exits" for every room I enter. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that for every room in my `nodes` list, all directions listed as available in that room's history have been traversed. If I am in a room with available directions, I must traverse them unless I have a confirmed record of having visited the destination via that specific direction previously. I will only stop when I am in a room with no available directions, or when I have confirmed that all available directions from all visited rooms lead to already visited rooms and have been traversed.

New plan: I prematurely issued "DONE" while in the Workshop, which still had an untried direction ("north") available. My previous strategy failed because I stopped based on the count of unique nodes visited rather than verifying that every available direction from every visited room had been explicitly traversed. Specifically, upon returning to the Workshop, I saw "north" and "west" as available; I had just come from "north" (Laundry) and went "west" (Solarium), but I failed to check if "north" led to a new room or if I had fully explored the path from Workshop to Laundry. Next time, I will maintain a strict "unexplored exits" list for every room. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that for every room in my `nodes` list, all directions that were ever available in that room have been traversed. If I am in a room with available directions, I must traverse any direction I haven't explicitly taken from that specific room yet, even if the destination seems familiar. I will only stop when I am in a room with no available directions, or when I have confirmed that all available directions from all visited rooms lead to already visited rooms and have been traversed. In this specific case, I should have gone "north" from the Workshop again to ensure the connection to Laundry was fully mapped or to see if a new path existed, rather than stopping.
